summary:
pinely is privately owned & funded HFT firm. 
We are hiring top talent globally!, founded in 2008. Type: private company. About 137 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: An Amsterdam high-frequency trading firm trading its own money, run by mathematicians and developers who often come from programming competitions.

culture.text: About 137 staff; top schools include Moscow's HSE, MIPT and the Yandex School of Data Analysis, mostly in computer science and maths.
It often finds people through programming contests like ICPC and Google HashCode, and works in small, autonomous teams with little hierarchy.
Team trips are a big part of the culture; staff have travelled together to 9 countries.

open.text: It is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Founded in 2008, it now has offices in Singapore, Cyprus and the Netherlands.

worth_knowing.text: It is a proprietary trading firm, so it trades only its own capital, not client money.
